_readme: Winner -> official @mention per network (tiktok, instagram, linkedin Page, bluesky). Never a #hashtag. A handle is used ONLY when verified is true: a human opened the account, saw the platform's verified badge or the brand's own site linking to it, and set verified=true, checked=YYYY-MM-DD, by=<who>. Unknown or unverified winners post with no tag. sensitive=true withholds the post only for a minor or a private individual. Politics is allowed. Never add an entry to chase a bigger account; the verdict comes first.
